Why go: a whole junk for your celebration

Chartering the Red Baron gives a group a large, stable wooden boat with room to eat at tables, lie in the sun and swim off the side. Its decks seat 16 for dining and 18 in the covered saloon, with 10 loungers on the upper deck, which is why it is a favourite for birthdays, company outings and weddings.

The price is fixed per boat for up to 20 guests, which makes it one of the best-value private charters on Koh Samui per head for large groups.

Which charter for which occasion

The sunset dinner cruise suits birthdays and farewell dinners: welcome drinks, appetisers, a swim and fishing stop, then a Thai buffet with ice cream as the sun sets. The half day anchors at Koh Som or the bays near Choeng Mon for swimming and lunch. The full day goes further, to Ang Thong, Koh Phangan or around Samui, with snorkelling and an island stop. The wedding cruise adds a celebrant, flowers and a sparkling toast at sunset. A DJ and photographer can be added to any charter.

Who it suits

  • Groups of 12–40 celebrating a birthday, anniversary or company event.
  • Couples planning a wedding or vow renewal at sea.
  • Multi-generation families who want shade, toilets and a stable deck.

Who should choose something else

  • Small groups of 2–6: a sailing catamaran is better value.
  • Anyone who wants a fast day to several islands: see our private speedboats.

Good to know

  • Speed: the junk cruises at about 6 knots, so Ang Thong takes about 2 hours each way.
  • Weddings: a ceremony at sea is symbolic; legal marriage in Thailand needs registration at an amphur office. See our wedding guide.
  • Booking: online booking for tomorrow closes at midnight Thai time.
